blocks.text: Systemic circulation phephron ke siwa jism ke tamam cells, tissues aur aza ko oxygenated khoon deti hai aur deoxygenated khoon wapas dil ko lati hai. Is ke yeh hisse hain:

Dil ki apni deewaron ko khoon systemic circulation ke ek chhote hisse se milta hai. Do coronary arteries, daen aur baen coronary artery, aorta ke shuru ke qareeb se nikalti hain. Yeh arteries bat kar bohat si chhoti arteries, phir arterioles aur phir capillaries banati hain. Dil ke muscles ko oxygenated khoon dene ke baad capillaries mil kar venules banati hain, jo bohat si coronary veins banati hain. Coronary veins mil kar coronary sinus banati hain, jo daen atrium mein khulta hai. Chhoti coronary veins seedhi daen atrium mein khul jati hain.

blocks.alt: Dil ke do manzar, oopar vena cava aur aorta. Saamne ka manzar (anterior): left aur right coronary arteries aorta ki jarr se nikal kar dil ki deewar par shakhein banati hain, saath coronary veins. Peeche ka manzar (posterior): coronary veins oopar ja kar bari coronary sinus mein milti hain jo dil ki pusht par se guzarti hai, aur saath right coronary artery hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Coronary sinus right atrium mein khulti hai. Dil ki apni deewar ko khoon in coronary arteries se milta hai, chambers ke khoon se nahin.

Portal system aisa daura hai jis mein veins (dil tak jane ke bajaye) capillaries par khatam hoti hain. Hepatic portal system mein ek bari hepatic portal vein tilli (spleen) aur alimentary canal (khaane ki nali aur aanton) se khoon ikattha kar ke jigar (liver) tak le jati hai. Jigar se khoon hepatic veins ke zariye dil tak jata hai.

blocks.alt: Jigar (liver) aur us ke saath maida, tilli (spleen) aur pancreas, aur neeche colon chhoti aant ko ghere hue. Chhoti aant, colon, pancreas aur spleen ki veins mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain, jo jigar mein ja kar shakhein banati hai. Hepatic veins jigar se khoon inferior vena cava mein le jati hain, jo beech mein oopar jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.15: Hepatic portal system (textbook ki Figure 11.15 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Inferior vena cava, Hepatic veins, Spleen, Pancreas, Hepatic portal vein, Ascending colon, Descending colon, Small intestine.

blocks.text: Alimentary canal se jigar tak aane wale khoon mein woh cheezein hoti hain jo chhoti aant (small intestine) ne jazb ki hoti hain. Yeh cheezein dil tak jane se pehle jigar se guzarti hain. Jigar khoon se nuqsan-deh (harmful) cheezein nikal deta hai aur nutrients ko zakhira (storage) karne ke liye le leta hai, phir yeh khoon dil ko bhejta hai. Hepatic portal system oesophagus (khaane ki nali) ke nichle hisse se le kar anal canal ke oopri hisse tak phaila hua hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Portal system mein vein capillaries se shuru ho kar doosri capillaries (jigar mein) par khatm hoti hai. Is liye aant se jazb hone wali cheezein pehle jigar se guzarti hain.

Yeh bhi systemic circulation ka ek ahem hissa hai. Daen aur baen renal arteries daen aur baen gurde (kidney) tak oxygenated khoon le jati hain. Gurde ke andar har renal artery baar baar bat kar chhoti arteries banati hai. Chhoti arteries bat kar kai afferent arterioles banati hain, jo nephrons (gurde ki kaam karne wali ikaiyan) ko khoon deti hain. Har afferent arteriole bat kar glomerulus ki capillaries banati hai.

Glomerulus ki capillaries mil kar efferent arteriole banati hain. Efferent arteriole phir bat kar capillaries ke do set banati hai: (i) peri-tubular capillaries (gurde ke cortex wale hisse mein nephron ki nali ke gird), aur (ii) vasa recta (gurde ke medulla mein nephron ki nali ke gird). Yeh capillaries mil kar venules banati hain, venules mil kar chhoti veins, aur chhoti veins mil kar renal vein banati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: nephron aur us ki khoon ki faraahmi. Chhoti artery afferent arteriole deti hai jo glomerulus banati hai; efferent arteriole us se nikal kar lipti tubule ke gird peri-tubular capillaries aur loop ke saath vasa recta banati hai; venule chhoti vein mein khulti hai. Daen: gurde ki qash jis mein renal artery se chhoti arteries phailti hain aur renal vein bahar nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Textbook is figure ki caption 'Renal portal system' chhapti hai, magar insaan mein renal portal system nahin hota (yeh machhli aur amphibians mein hota hai); kitab ka apna heading 'Renal Circulation' hai. Yahan afferent arteriole -> glomerulus -> efferent arteriole -> peri-tubular capillaries/vasa recta -> venule -> renal vein ka raasta hai, is liye caption 'Renal circulation' likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Portal system ghair-mamooli kyun hai, aur hepatic portal system jism ko kya faida deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar circuits mein vein khoon seedha dil ko lautati hai, magar portal system mein vein capillaries ke doosre bed par khatm hoti hai. Hepatic portal vein tilli aur alimentary canal ka khoon, jo chhoti aant mein abhi jazb shuda maddon se bhara hai, pehle jigar ki capillaries mein le jati hai, taake jigar nuqsan-deh maddey hata aur nutrients zakheera kar sake, phir hepatic veins khoon dil aur baqi jism tak bhejti hain.

items: Artery: dil se door khoon; teen tahein, moti muscular tunica media jo zyada dabao sehti hai. Capillary: endothelial cells ki ek tah, taqreeban 8 micrometre; yahin len den hota hai aur interstitial fluid bahar risata hai. Vein: dil ki taraf khoon; patli tunica media, semilunar valves, khali ho kar pichak jati hai.

Capillaries mein bahao: nerves tang karti hain, histamine chaura karti hai, pre-capillary sphincters loops ko kholte band karte hain. Arterioles: muscles sukrein to vasoconstriction (kam khoon), dheele hon to vasodilation (zyada khoon).
Raftar: aorta 450-500 mm/s, capillaries sab se kam (taqreeban 1 mm/s), vena cavae 250-300 mm/s.

Pulmonary circulation: daan ventricle → pulmonary trunk → phephre → pulmonary veins → baan atrium. Systemic circulation ke hisse: coronary (aorta → dil ki deewar → coronary sinus → daan atrium), hepatic portal (aanten aur tilli → hepatic portal vein → jigar → hepatic veins), renal (renal artery → afferent arteriole → glomerulus → efferent arteriole → peri-tubular capillaries aur vasa recta → renal vein).
